project.name: osgi/domains/ndh
project.description: The ndh domain — the rke2lab ↔ nix-darwin-home boundary. From rke2lab's point of view ndh is an external system (the operator's key inventory + host config), so reading it is a domain contact, not a foundation utility — the worktree domain's shape: ndh-contract holds the NdhKeystoreReader seam, ndh-core the @Component that reads .ndh-ssh.d/keys.yaml. One source of truth for the operator key material, consumed by manifests-core (the rke2-cluster age key) and cluster-pki-core (the mammoth-skate-tls root + rke2-cluster).
